detailed_feedback.explanation: Your resume does not include a Professional Summary or Objective section at the top. While not required, a 2-3 line summary helps recruiters quickly understand your profile and target role.
detailed_feedback.where_it_appears: Top of resume — below contact info
detailed_feedback.how_to_fix: Add a 2-3 sentence summary highlighting your experience level, key skills, and career focus. Tailor it to the job you're applying for.
action_items: Add a 'PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY' or 'OBJECTIVE' section at the top of your resume
Write 2–3 sentences: who you are, your key skills, and what role you seek
Mention your years of experience or education level upfront
Tailor this section for each job application — reference the specific role
Keep it under 60 words — recruiters spend only 6 seconds on first scan
